name: Kuragano Sera
source:
Gekka-kai's student council president. She is in the same year as the protagonist but in a different class. Because of her famous family background and her elegant behavior, she will accept anyone as a member of Gekka-kai no matter who they are. Because of her figure and looks, she is very popular with the boys. But because of her high-profile treatment of others and her popularity, very few people accosted her. She also has an unexpected side of her love for cute things.

[spoiler]Under the alias of Ares, she plays with Kazuma in an online game, but neither of them knows their true name until it is revealed during her route.[/spoiler]

[spoiler] Her being mentioned / guest appearance in PRIMAL×HEARTS 2 will only happen if you have entered Mashiro / Alicetia's route. She will be the lover of Kazuma in Mashiro’s route. [/spoiler]
